  180  ITEM 8.01.
  181  OTHER EVENTS.
  182  On September 14, 2026,
  183  Amazon.com, Inc. (the “Company”) closed the sale of £1,250,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 5.200% notes
  184  due 2029 (the “2029 Notes”), £1,000,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 5.550% notes due 2032 (the “2032
  185  Notes”), £1,000,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 6.250% notes due 2038 (the “2038 Notes”), and £1,000,000,000
  186  aggregate principal amount of its 6.650% notes due 2045 (the “2045 Notes” and, together with the 2029 Notes, 2032 Notes, and
  187  2038 Notes, the “Notes”) pursuant to an Underwriting Agreement dated September 9, 2026 (the “Underwriting Agreement”)
  188  among the Company and the several underwriters named therein. The sale of the Notes was registered under the Company’s registration
  189  statement on Form S-3 filed on February 6, 2026 (File No. 333-293246).
  190  The aggregate public offering
  191  price of the Notes was £4.242 billion and the estimated net proceeds from the offering were approximately £4.235 billion,
  192  after deducting underwriting discounts from the public offering price and before deducting offering expenses payable by us. The Notes
  193  were issued pursuant to an Indenture dated as of November 29, 2012 between the Company and Wells Fargo Bank, National Association,
  194  as trustee (the “Prior Trustee”), as amended and supplemented by Supplemental Indenture No. 1, dated as of April 13,
  195  2022, among the Company, the Prior Trustee, and Computershare Trust Company, National Association, as successor trustee, together with
  196  the officers’ certificate dated as of September 14, 2026 issued pursuant thereto establishing the terms of each series of the
  197  Notes (the “Officers’ Certificate”).
  198  The foregoing descriptions
  199  of the Underwriting Agreement and the Officers’ Certificate are qualified in their entirety by the terms of such documents, which
  200  are filed as Exhibit 1.1 and Exhibit 4.1, respectively, and incorporated herein by reference. The foregoing description of
  201  the Notes is qualified in its entirety by reference to the full text of the form of 2029 Note, form of 2032 Note, form of 2038 Note,
  202  and form of 2045 Note, which are filed hereto as Exhibit 4.2, Exhibit 4.3, Exhibit 4.4, and Exhibit 4.5, respectively,
  203  and incorporated herein by reference.
